protocol.purpose: Post steady-clock fix coarse sweep: 32K partitions 8,6,9,5,7,4; two excluded warmups and four timed independent retrievals per fresh load. Frozen order spreads sizes; later finalist reverse-order replication required.
protocol.checks: Correct retrieval, no cache reuse, no swap, expected expert work/copy counters, no peer error; abort and restore on failure.
protocol.finalist_protocol: Choose top three by mean 32K prompt latency; repeat all three in reverse ranking and then forward ranking, identical six requests per load; assess load-level mean and variance separately at 8K and32K. No optimum claim from coarse samples alone.
protocol.activation: No serving default change until repeated finalist timings, retrieval checks and relevant numerical checks reviewed.

scope: All six per-arm measurements and coarse workflow completed; accepted fallback restored healthy at phase end. Refinement is separate and currently in progress.
